name: @appbana/runtime-session
description: AppBana Genesis runtime session lifecycle — startSession(appId, principal) → sessionId with persistent session state and graceful shutdown that flushes buffered trace events. Phase 1 scope (WS-1.4 Task 2): composes @appbana/platform-kernel's resolveCam() with an injected session store and trace sink; emits session-lifecycle trace events (event.session.started / event.session.state.updated / event.session.ended / event.session.aborted).
